description.value: A takeout-only concession kiosk operated within Sunset Beach Park on Vancouver's waterfront. The stand sits directly along the Seaside Greenway, one of the city's most popular cycling routes connecting Stanley Park to the Burrard Bridge. It offers a quick grab-and-go stop for cyclists passing through this busy beach corridor.
